import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "score": [85.5, 92.3, 78.9, 88.1, 95.6],
})

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using a bytes buffer
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the Parquet bytes and create a new buffer for reading
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)

# Read the Parquet data back into a fresh DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

# Confirm round trip
print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)
print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)
print("\nRound trip successful:", df_original.equals(df_restored))

import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "score": [85.5, 92.3, 78.9, 88.1, 95.6],
})

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using a bytes buffer
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the Parquet bytes and create a new buffer for reading
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)

# Read the Parquet data back into a fresh DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

# Confirm round trip
print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)
print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)
print("\nRound trip successful:", df_original.equals(df_restored))
